n, m, P = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
C = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
f1 = [0] * (maxn)
g1 = [0] * (maxn)
f2 = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]
g2 = [[0] * (maxn) for _ in range(maxn)]

# Compute binomial coefficients modulo P
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % P

# Compute f1 and g1
f1[0] = 1
g1[0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1[i] = (f1[i] + f1[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        t = (f1[j - 1] * g1[i - j] + g1[j - 1] * f1[i - j]) % P
        t = t * (i + 1) % P
        g1[i] = (g1[i] + (f1[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % P * (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) % P + t) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
    f1[i] = (f1[i] * (i + 1)) % P

# Compute f2 and g2
f2[0][0] = 1
g2[0][0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
        f2[i][j] = f2[i - 1][j]
        g2[i][j] = g2[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            if i - k - 1 >= 0:
                f_prev = f2[i - k - 1][j - k]
                g_prev = g2[i - k - 1][j - k]
            else:
                f_prev = 1
                g_prev = 0
            f2[i][j] = (f2[i][j] + f_prev * f1[k] % P * C[j][k]) % P
            g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + (f_prev * g1[k] + g_prev * f1[k]) % P * C[j][k]) % P

print(g2[n][m])
